# Historical evidence fixtures

These seven documents are verbatim inputs to the existing review, proposal,
integration and research-audit tests. They preserve the text those tests
assert, including historical paths and line numbers. Those paths are quoted
evidence, not current links or runtime dependencies.

HYG1 retained only the documents read by those tests. Current coordination
belongs in the ignored root `handoff/` directory. Do not add new lane notes,
queues or reviews here as part of ongoing work.
